$comment: Where this site’s committed data came from. Written when the folder was first committed; `bun run fetch muenchen` and `bun run bake muenchen` regenerate everything from the sources named here (raw downloads live in data/_raw/by/, never committed).
retrieved: 2026-09-24 (provider products); Wikidata and the re-bake of the bridge steps 2026-09-27

provider.name: Bayerische Vermessungsverwaltung (LDBV)
products: Basis-DLM (land cover, tree rows, rail, bridges, monuments)

committed.data/muenchen/dgm/: DGM1 per tile, clipped to the 2 km grid and written compact (DEFLATE, float predictor, centimetres) by `bun run fetch`
committed.data/muenchen/cityjson/: LoD2 per tile, converted from the provider’s CityGML by pipeline/bake/citygml.py
committed.data/muenchen/dlm/: the derived per-tile artifacts of `bun run bake` (class raster, canopy, vegetation, OSM layers, …)
committed.data/muenchen/dop/: per-tile values derived from the orthophoto (roof colours)

openstreetmap.licence: Open Database License (ODbL); credit: © OpenStreetMap contributors
openstreetmap.usedFor: walls, stairs, lamps, street furniture, fountains, paving, markings, trams, riverside, sport, shops and heritage

wikidata.usedFor: bridge names and types, cached per tile under data/_raw/by/wikidata/
